implementation_summary.task_1.1_timeout_unit: Changed FETCH_AGENT_RULES timeout from 30 (seconds) to 30000 (milliseconds) in agent_rules.py. Updated description to explicitly mention milliseconds.
implementation_summary.task_1.2_sanitize_function: Added sanitize_error_message() function and SENSITIVE_PATTERNS constant to validators/__init__.py. Masks user paths, tokens, passwords, removes control characters, escapes template braces, and truncates long messages.
implementation_summary.task_1.3_prompt_feedback: Enhanced ValidationResult.to_prompt_feedback() with max_errors (default 5) and max_total_length (default 2000) parameters. Added severity-based sorting (critical > major > minor) and error message sanitization.
implementation_summary.task_1.5_prompt_builder: Added error_feedback parameter (default '') to PromptBuilderSubWorkflow.build() and assemble_prompt(). Passes through to WorkflowPrompt.
implementation_summary.task_1.6_yaml_generator_retry: Updated YamlGeneratorSubWorkflow.generate_with_llm() to generate error_feedback from ValidationResult on retry attempts and pass it to generate_from_task().
implementation_summary.task_1.7_api_deduplication_warning: Added DeprecationWarning in assemble_prompt() when both recommended_apis and api_mappings are provided, warning about potential API info duplication.
